title: SpaceX Buys AI Coding Firm

slides.headline: SpaceX Buys AI Coding Firm
slides.subtitle: Plus big updates from D23 and the future of fusion energy.

slides.headline: Ahsoka Returns With Darker Twists
slides.explanation: Lucasfilm just dropped the first trailer for the second season of Ahsoka at D23. The new season promises a darker, witchcraft-focused tone when it premieres in January 2027.

slides.headline: Marvel And Star Wars Updates
slides.explanation: Disney used D23 to reveal new looks at the X-Men movie, Avengers: Doomsday, and the VisionQuest series. These projects signal a major push to refresh the Marvel and Star Wars lineups for fans.

slides.headline: SpaceX Acquires AI Coding Startup
slides.explanation: SpaceX has finalized its purchase of the AI coding platform Cursor. This $60 billion deal marks a major expansion for the company into software development tools.

slides.headline: Cursor Is Now Part Of SpaceX
slides.explanation: The AI coding startup Cursor is now officially operating under the SpaceX umbrella. This move highlights how deeply AI is becoming integrated into aerospace engineering workflows.

slides.headline: Fusion Energy Funding Hits $7 Billion
slides.explanation: Fusion startups have raised over $7 billion, though most of that money is concentrated in just a few companies. It shows that investors are betting big on the potential for clean, limitless power.
